steps.name: apply-stage21a-canonical-replay-fixture
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=adb5e63a2148a322b67500a9df1d97f3f4037a93; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage21/apply_stage21a_canonical_replay_fixture.py > /tmp/apply-stage21a-canonical-replay-fixture.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-stage21a-canonical-replay-fixture.py; PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python tools/ml/generate_climate_replay_fixture.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix tools/ml/generate_climate_replay_fixture.py tests/test_climate_replay_fixture.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff format tools/ml/generate_climate_replay_fixture.py tests/test_climate_replay_fixture.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-stage21a-canonical-replay-fixture
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_climate_replay_fixture.py tests/test_climate_replay.py tests/test_climate_runtime_parity.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check tools/ml/generate_climate_replay_fixture.py tests/test_climate_replay_fixture.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check tools/ml/generate_climate_replay_fixture.py tests/test_climate_replay_fixture.py; PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python tools/ml/generate_climate_replay_fixture.py --output /tmp/climate-runtime-replay.ndjson; cmp tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson /tmp/climate-runtime-replay.ndjson; test "$(wc -l < tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_replay.ndjson | tr -d ' ')" = 12; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-stage21a
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -A; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -A; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add canonical climate replay fixture'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; printf 'PUBLISHED_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
